summary: The Sprint 00 Project Foundation implementation demonstrates excellent architectural alignment with the ADRs and implementation plans. The KMP project structure follows ADR-001 with proper module separation (shared/android/desktop), the version catalog centralizes dependency management effectively, and CI/CD pipelines provide comprehensive multi-platform coverage. The architecture establishes solid foundations for future development with appropriate separation of concerns, clean module boundaries, and proper tooling configuration. Minor improvements are recommended around test coverage setup, dependency consistency, and version catalog usage.

issues.message: Dependency versions are hardcoded in shared module instead of using version catalog
issues.suggestion: Replace hardcoded versions (e.g., '1.7.3', '1.6.2', '0.5.0') with version catalog references (e.g., libs.kotlinx.coroutines.core) for consistency with android and desktop modules

issues.message: Test source sets (jvmTest, androidUnitTest, desktopTest) lack explicit configuration for test dependencies
issues.suggestion: Add test dependencies to jvmTest, androidUnitTest, and desktopTest source sets to enable platform-specific testing as specified in implementation plan

issues.message: Empty domain/data/services directories created without any placeholder interfaces or documentation
issues.suggestion: Consider adding package-info or README files to document intended layer responsibilities per the clean architecture pattern from ADR-001

issues.message: Android product flavors use assembleDebug but CI workflow references generic 'debug' variant without flavor qualifier
issues.suggestion: Update CI workflow to explicitly use flavor variants (e.g., assembleProdDebug or assembleDevDebug) for deterministic builds

issues.message: Development tooling (ktlint, detekt, dokka) applied uniformly to all subprojects without considering module-specific needs
issues.suggestion: Current approach is acceptable for Phase 0, but consider module-specific configurations as the codebase grows (e.g., different detekt thresholds for test code)

issues.message: Desktop build conditional logic may cause inconsistent CI behavior across PRs vs main branch
issues.suggestion: Consider building desktop on all platforms consistently or documenting the rationale for the conditional build strategy

issues.message: Hardcoded upgrade UUID should be documented or generated deterministically
issues.suggestion: Add comment explaining UUID purpose and consider using a well-documented generation approach for reproducibility

issues.message: Version catalog defines plugins but root build.gradle.kts uses inline version declarations
issues.suggestion: Migrate root build.gradle.kts to use alias(libs.plugins.*) syntax for full version catalog consistency

recommendations: Migrate all hardcoded dependency versions in shared/build.gradle.kts to version catalog references for single-source-of-truth dependency management
Configure test source sets in shared module with explicit test dependencies to support TDD approach required by implementation plan (>80% coverage target)
Update Android CI workflow to specify explicit flavor variants (devDebug/prodDebug) for deterministic builds
Consider extracting common ProGuard rules shared between Android and Desktop into a shared configuration file to reduce duplication
Add ARCHITECTURE.md or expand CLAUDE.md to document the intended layer boundaries and module responsibilities as the codebase grows
The jvmMain source set pattern for shared JVM code is well-designed and aligns with ADR-001 recommendations - maintain this separation as platform-specific implementations are added
